description: Photograph of a physical copy of the USA Today front page dated Wednesday, September 2, 2020. The lead story is headlined 'How QAnon is radicalizing Americans' with subhead 'Conspiracy movement rises out of national upheaval', illustrated by a Getty/AFP photo of QAnon demonstrators on Hollywood Boulevard in Los Angeles on Aug. 22, 2020 — a man waves a large Q flag reading 'Where we go one, we go all' in front of Disney and Ghirardelli storefronts. A partially cropped left column covers President Trump's visit to Kenosha, Wisconsin after the police shooting of Jacob Blake; a sidebar previews actress Yifei Liu in Mulan.

description: Screenshot of Q drop #4373, posted May 31, 2020 at 19:47:15 (EST) under tripcode !!Hs1Jq13jV6, board ID b785d4, post No. 9402777. The drop claims Americans are witnessing the greatest coordinated disinformation campaign ever launched against them, listing 'information warfare', 'infiltration v invasion', 'insurgency', 'irregular warfare', and framing them as '[D]' (Democrat) efforts to regain power.

description: Satirical photo-composite meme styled as a holiday greeting card. Cut-out images of California Governor Gavin Newsom and House Speaker Nancy Pelosi, posed smiling side by side, are superimposed over a scene of California wildfires with hillside homes engulfed in flames and smoke. The caption 'Happy Holidays' frames the pair mockingly against the disaster backdrop.
flags: Composited/photoshopped image — Newsom and Pelosi were not photographed at this scene

description: Screenshot of Q drop #4425 as rendered in a dark-themed Q aggregator app, posted 5 June 2020 under tripcode !!Hs1Jq13jV6. The drop is titled with the question 'Generals Mattis, Kelly and McMaster to Hold Town Hall With Anderson Cooper in September?', links to an Arthur Schwartz tweet, and claims a 'full MSDNC blitzkrieg' (Q's pejorative merging MSNBC/DNC) with 'October surprise(s) being prepped and warmed'.
text: 4425. Generals Mattis, Kelly and McMaster to Hold Town Hall With Anderson Cooper in September?. Q !!Hs1Jq13jV6. 5 Jun 2020 - 12:07:25 PM. https://twitter.com/ArthurSchwartz/status/1268928282990387200. Full MSDNC blitzkrieg. Known and ready. October surprise(s) being prepped and warmed. Q
flags: The town-hall claim and 'October surprise' framing are the drop's claims, sourced to a tweet, not established fact
